sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Apparelist is a media brand and community that provides business management resources, expert content, and educational information to apparel decorating businesses of all sizes.

Industry: B2B Media & Information Services · Size: <$50M · Products: Newsletters, Webinars, Live Events, Online Resources, Educational Guides

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Apparelist scores 15 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (11/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (22% similar on printing, media, print, resources); Drytac (22% similar on media, print, printing, graphics); ORAFOL Europe (10% similar on printing, information, graphics, digital). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
